name: smoke
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/smoke; mkdir -p $O
python3 decor_build.py -- --theme olive --out $O --tex 512 --ao 4 --only Rock_A > $O/build.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/build.log; exit 1)
ls -la $O

name: mkit_farmland
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/mkit_farmland; mkdir -p $O
python3 decor_build.py -- --theme farmland --out $O --fine --tex 2048 --ao 24 --shots $O/shots --each > $O/build.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/build.log; exit 1)
grep '^\[kit\]' $O/build.log | tail -4; rm -f $O/kit_hi.blend

name: treb
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/treb; mkdir -p $O/hi $O/final
python3 sculpt_char.py --character trebuchet --fine --out $O/hi/trebuchet_hi.blend --shots $O/hi/shots_fine > $O/char.log 2>&1 & CP=$!
python3 sculpt_base.py --module trebuchet_base --fine --out $O/hi/trebuchet_base_hi.blend --shots $O/hi/base_shots_fine > $O/base.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/base.log; exit 1)
wait $CP || (tail -40 $O/char.log; exit 1)
python3 build_game.py -- --character trebuchet --char $O/hi/trebuchet_hi.blend --base $O/hi/trebuchet_base_hi.blend --out $O/final --tex 2048 --ao 40 > $O/bake.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/bake.log; exit 1)
ls -la $O/final; rm -f $O/hi/*.blend
